title: Skull Ballet Despair
description: A surreal festive scene features a giant green skull with red sunglasses and blood dripping from its mouth, exhaling purple smoke with musical notes. In a snowy room decorated with Christmas trees and ornaments, multiple dancing skeletons in pink tutus perform ballet, one playing a guitar while another reads a large black book titled 'DESPAIR'.
